# opstracer_log_alert_monitor (Resource)

Polls the logs of one source (e.g. a Railway service) so that `opstracer_log_alert_rule` rules can raise alerts from them. Log alerts must be enabled for the org. Only `enabled` can change in place; other changes replace the monitor, and deleting it deletes its rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opstracer_log_alert_monitor" "api" {
  source_type    = "railway"
  integration_id = "<railway-integration-id>"
  scope = {
    project_id     = "<railway-project-id>"
    environment_id = "<railway-environment-id>"
    service_id     = "<railway-service-id>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_id` (String) Integration that receives the alerts the rules raise.
- `scope` (Map of String) Which logs of the source to poll, e.g. Railway `project_id`, `environment_id` and `service_id`.
- `source_type` (String) Log source type, e.g. `railway`.

### Optional

- `connection_id` (String) Observability connection used to read the logs. Defaults to the org default connection for the source.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Set to false to stop polling without deleting the monitor.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Monitor ID.
- `scope_name` (String) Display name of the scope.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opstracer_log_alert_monitor.api <monitor-id>
```
